content.text: Settings: crafting mode, OP legendaries, variants, Picker mode, loot drop rate.
Legendary Picker: the families the workbench shows in Picker mode.
Concise view: show whole groups of similar legendaries.
CLM Perks / Cheat Perks: add or remove the perks of the perk holotape.

<font color='#AAAAAA'>CLM's settings and Legendary Picker live here instead of on holotapes and "CLM Setting" / "CLM Pick" items: nothing to carry. (Items you already had are turned into these settings.)</font>

content.help: Costly: legendaries cost components. Free: they cost nothing. Loot mode: they drop from enemies instead (carry a CLM holotape to craft its family; OP ones need a Legendary Core).
How often loot mode drops legendaries. Standard: common 3%, uncommon 1%, rare 0.3%, OP 0.1% per kill.
Loot mode: the legendaries the concise view hides can drop and be crafted too.
Show every legendary, as before 2.1. Off: the concise view, one legendary per group of similar effects (turn on single groups in the Concise view page).
Also show the overpowered legendaries.
Show every strength and variant of each legendary.
Hide the legendaries that work like perks (Jumpy, Speedy, Nimble...).
Hide the legendaries that spawn creatures and people.
The workbench shows only the families turned on in the Legendary Picker page.
This menu replaces the configuration and perk holotapes. Turn this on to get both holotapes (and their recipes) back anyway.

content.text: Turn settings and picks back into items
content.help: Use this before uninstalling CLM - MCM: your settings and picks become "CLM Setting" / "CLM Pick" items again (as without F4SE), the chemistry station shows them again and the holotapes come back. Changing any option here afterwards switches the menu back on.

content.text: <font color='#AAAAAA'>With Picker mode on (Settings page), the workbench shows only the families turned on here. Your other settings still apply (OP, variants...).</font>
